title: Plan To Eradicate The Three Hero Church
paragraphs: It happened one day. We received a message from the queen, and all the heroes were summoned to the castle.
“Heroes, I believe someone impersonating me will send instructions soon… I would like you to go to the specified location, avoid the trap, and take them down.”
“Huh? It’s not impossible, but… that sounds pretty dangerous.”
“Indeed. It seems like something’s about to happen.”
“Yes… Also, I’d like you to leave behind the strongest among those we’ve been training in the village that day to reduce the number of people in the village.”
“Is something going to happen?”
“My prediction is that the Three Heroes Church will reveal its true colors and, leading the nobles, they will invade the castle and the territory of Seatto in an attempt to oust me.”
“No way…”
“Is there no way to prevent it in advance?”
“It’s not impossible, but this time the plan is to let them act and destroy the legitimacy of the Three Heroes Church.”
“I see. So we’re going to crush the religion that tried to have Naofumi killed through discrimination.”
The queen nodded at Ren’s words.

“According to the shadow’s investigation, it seems the Three Heroes Church will use the trump card they’ve been hiding, just as Kitamura-sama predicted. They will likely lure us out one by one by pretending to speak on my behalf, so I ask the heroes to be prepared.”
“Of course.”
“Thank you very much for cooperating in rooting out the rot in this country.”
“Don’t worry about it. This is something that needs to be done to move forward.”
“If it were up to me, I’d just burn down the Three Heroes Church’s headquarters with magic in one go!”
As I said that, Father, along with Ren and Itsuki, shook their heads in denial.
“It’s a dangerous task… but it’s probably something unavoidable if we’re serious about rebuilding the village.”
“Yeah. No matter what, I sometimes feel the hostility directed at us.”
“So, once we win, we’ll expose the Three Heroes Church as evil and persuade the people to convert… is that the plan?”
The queen nodded at Ren’s words. That’s right. This is a great opportunity to expose the Three Heroes Church as the true source of evil.

“After the second wave, the people already understand the threat it poses. Once this issue is dealt with, they will realize that they cannot survive without the heroes. At the same time, we can get rid of the Three Heroes Church, which is pushing for war despite such a threat.”
“This is the decisive moment…”
“Yes. Therefore, I’d like the heroes to handle this matter with the utmost secrecy.”
I see, if too many people know, it could lead to failure.
So, who should I talk to? Would it be alright to tell the Filolials?
“Motoyasu-kun, make sure you absolutely don’t tell the Filolials.”
“Why is that?”
“Because it would be obvious if they found out through the Filolials! In fact, aside from the heroes, no one should know about this!”
What!? I can’t tell anyone and have to keep it a secret!? This is going to be a very difficult mission.
“Understood. …Finally, we can bring justice.”

“Yeah. There’s no way those who framed Naofumi and tried to have us kill him could be in the right. Motoyasu said before that Itsuki’s sense of justice sometimes runs into problems, but this time, there’s no mistake.”
“…Yeah. It would be nice if we could reconcile, but…”

“Of course, I have repeatedly given stern warnings to the Three Heroes Church. I told them that the world is under the threat of the waves, and now is not the time for war… But it seems they have no intention of listening.”
The queen answered with a troubled expression.
“Ren and Itsuki were sometimes called in for meetings.”
“Yes, we went under the queen’s orders.”
“But… those guys seemed to be letting the words go in one ear and out the other.”
“And without fail, there was always a mysterious attacker waiting when they were leaving.”
“Their favorite line is always, ‘Die! You impostor, pretending to be a hero!’ It’s impossible not to be suspicious.”
Ren and Itsuki are already strong enough. Thanks to their efforts in the Dracia Mountains.
“It seems like talking isn’t going to work. In that case, both Itsuki and I have decided we have no choice but to act.”
“They say conflict arises when understanding isn’t possible…”
If anything, this is exactly that.
“Idiots don’t learn unless they die. The Three Heroes Church is a plague on this world. There’s no way we can reconcile with them to move forward.”
“Seems that way.”
“It’s harsh to say this to Queen and Naofumi, who sought a path to reconciliation, but there are some enemies with whom understanding is simply impossible.”
“Let’s steel ourselves and deal with this.”

And so, we made our preparations. A few days later, the incident finally occurred. That day, under the queen’s orders, we left the village, with all the heroes heading out together as instructed. Of course, we were summoned individually by someone impersonating the queen. Following those orders, we left the village. While we were away, fires broke out in the village houses. Just as predicted, the Three Heroes Church launched their attack. That day, those who remained in the village were the Filolials and some of the slaves… all of whom had already been properly trained by me and Father, and their levels were sufficiently high. The attackers were easily captured, but the assault happened on multiple fronts, affecting both Fiancée and Éclair, who were in the neighboring town. Well, thanks to Fiancée, whose capabilities had been greatly enhanced, and Éclair, who had excellent combat instincts, they managed to repel most of the attackers. The first to arrive on the scene was Father and the others, who had been leveling up near the coast. Dozens of warships appeared and began bombarding the village. With the cooperation of big sister, they successfully repelled the Three Heroes Church.
“I won’t let them take anything this time!”

The big sisters’s friend boarded the warship, transformed into a weasel beastman, and swiftly tore through the enemy. Big sister’s sister electrocuted the enemies with lightning magic, while the Big sister’s friend confused the attackers with illusion magic, wiping them all out. And so, as planned, we returned. As expected, like a broken record, they tried to eliminate us heroes with ritual magic. The moment I arrived, I absorbed the ritual magic with Absorb and wiped them out with Liberation Firestorm X. Ren, proud of himself, said that as soon as the attack started, he used Hundred Sword X and Meteor Sword X to suppress those casting the ritual magic and swiftly took them down. Itsuki did something similar. He incapacitated them with Arrow Storm X.
“Everything’s going as planned.”
“Did you report to the castle?”
“Well, it seems smoke is rising from the castle as well, and the Three Heroes Church has begun moving to overthrow the queen.”
“We should hurry over!”
“Indeed! Let’s go through the portal!”
“Yeah!”
“Um… what should we do?”
Big sister’s friend, holding the slightly frightened big sister’s hand, asked. Big sister was looking around cautiously, keeping an eye out for any more attackers.
“Raphatalia-chan, Rifana-chan, and the others should stay and protect the village since it’s dangerous. Sadina-san, can I ask you to stay as well?”
“Of course. But things sure are getting messy.”
“Well… it was an incident that had been planned in secret.”
“We tried to reconcile as much as we could, but it was impossible.”
“That’s why we evacuated the non-combatants to Zeltoble, where it’s safer. Rat returned to Faubley as well.”
“I would have appreciated a heads-up, though.”
Father bowed repeatedly in apology to big sister.
“Sorry. We did everything we could on our end.”
Big sister gave a wry smile and placed her hand gently on Father’s shoulder.
“It’s fine. Driving out the forces that wanted to destroy the village was necessary, right? The damage was minimal, and there were zero casualties. I’m not going to complain.”
“Kou worked hard!”
“Me too, Sakura!”
Kou and Sakura raised their hands.
“Kuro also fought alongside Ren in an electrifying battle so intense they called him ‘Black Thunder!’”
Kuro struck a cool pose to show off. Ren gave Kuro an exasperated look.
